$meta.title: Paper II (EA/PR/VDR, van Fraassen-to-duality) — attempt taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the Paper-II problem collection. Load first for the shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill in.
$meta.what_is_it: Paper II indexes three realism positions — EA (empirical adequacy) ⊂ PR (property realism) ⊂ VDR (value-definite realism) — by DISTRIBUTIVITY of the event algebra, bridging McDonald–Bimbó OML duality to the van Fraassen realism debate.
$meta.status: REVISE — the SURVIVOR, the programme's strongest novelty zone. Audited 2026-06-23: central math SOUND, no fatal error, no retirement. Type-6 (exposition/bridge) bar CLEARS; Type 1/2/4 FAIL or weak. Submit after blocking fixes.
$meta.the_shape: The contribution is a Type-6 BRIDGE (McDonald–Bimbó quantum-logic duality ↔ van Fraassen realism, via Gleason/Kochen–Specker), NOT a theorem-novelty win. Crown jewel = the clustering argument (PR_dual fails for L(H)) — correct, but a KS/Pitowsky repackage, so claim USE not discovery. The structural payload (distributivity ⟺ commensurability of EA/PR/VDR) survives cleanly. Four BLOCKING fixes before submission, all fixable (citations + notation + a stale cross-reference), no broken proof.
$meta.scope_note: EXCLUDES the programme_reception/ files (historical_placement, field_by_field, novelty_audit, novelty_summary) — verified by inventory to describe a WITHDRAWN three-paper observational arc, NOT Paper II (zero EA/PR/VDR or van Fraassen content). Those stay as standalone historical docs; genealogy + contribution_evaluation are programme-meta, also excluded.

categories.result: an established mathematical result in the paper

contributions.name: Type-6 bridge: McDonald–Bimbó ↔ van Fraassen
contributions.one_line: STRONGEST survivor. Bridges quantum-logic OML duality (McDonald–Bimbó 2023) to the van Fraassen realism debate via Gleason/Kochen–Specker, for an audience owning neither strand. Type-6 bar CLEARS; rest the contribution HERE.

contributions.name: Type-4 vocabulary (EA/PR/VDR trichotomy)
contributions.one_line: The named axis EA⊂PR⊂VDR is folklore-adjacent (pieces owned: van Fraassen modal/value split; Beltrametti–Cassinelli 1981 statistical vs dispersion-free). Three-statements test MARGINAL. Drop the Type-4 lean; novelty is in packaging + bridge, not the taxonomy.

results.name: Clustering argument (crown jewel)
results.one_line: CORRECT: no normal state on L(H) (dim≥3) extends to a charge on the dual S₀(L(H)) — PR_dual FAILS. Independently verified; distinct from Paper I's phantom-point failure mode. But it is a KS/Pitowsky repackage ⟹ claim USE, not discovery.

results.name: Distributivity ⟺ commensurability
results.one_line: Structural theorem: Boolean ⟹ EA/PR/VDR all commensurable; OML (dim≥3) ⟹ VDR blocked (Kochen–Specker). The distributivity axis as organizing principle — the structural payload, independent of the clustering argument. Survives audit cleanly.

results.name: PR_lat / PR_dual split
results.one_line: PR splits in the OML case: PR_lat (σ-add measure on the lattice, holds via Gleason) vs PR_dual (descent to a measure on the dual, FAILS). Partially owned by Döring 2008 (states↔measures on Sub_cl(Σ); no-global-sections=KS). Differentiators real (σ-additivity separator, MB not spectral presheaf, van Fraassen) ⟹ packaging novelty.

concepts.name: Coherence filtration S(A)⊇S_σ(A)⊇S_df(A)
concepts.one_line: Three transitions (pasting, regularity, sharpness) unified under one distributivity-indexed ladder; not assembled as a single ladder before. Part of the Type-6 bridge contribution.

owned.name: Kochen–Specker (VDR blockade)
owned.one_line: KS proves VDR impossible on L(H) dim≥3; deployed as the OML blockade. Correctly cited, not claimed.

owned.name: Gleason (PR_lat holds)
owned.one_line: Gleason 1957: a σ-additive measure on L(H) exists; the bridge showing PR_lat is available when PR_dual fails. Correctly deployed.

owned.name: Bub–Clifton partial VDR
owned.one_line: Given a state + preferred observable, a unique maximal Boolean subalgebra admits value-definite descent (contextual, not global) = the OML partial VDR. Correctly cited.

owned.name: Putnam–Dummett realism↔distributivity
owned.one_line: Putnam 1968 / Friedman–Putnam 1978 / Dummett own the realism↔distributivity link; Paper II lives inside this decades-old debate. Cited, context correctly positioned.

blocking_gaps.name: Döring 2008 prior-art (MISSING)
blocking_gaps.one_line: CRITICAL — single largest prior-art gap. Döring 2008 (arXiv:0809.4847) already has the PR_lat/PR_dual distinction (states↔measures on Sub_cl(Σ); no-global-sections=KS). Must CITE + differentiate (σ-additivity separator, MB not spectral presheaf, van Fraassen engagement). Currently absent from bib.

blocking_gaps.name: Stairs 1983 entitlement-decoupling (MISSING)
blocking_gaps.one_line: CRITICAL — Stairs 1983 (Phil. Sci. 50:578) already owns the §4 upshot: value-definiteness 'has nothing to do with realism' (p.583), grounds in Boolean-representability (p.585) = Paper II's PR middle layer. Absent from bib; would sink §4 with any informed referee.

blocking_gaps.name: p_i^⊥ notation bug in clustering footnote
blocking_gaps.one_line: Footnote uses standard L(H) p_i^⊥=I−p_i, making s(p_i)+s(p_i^⊥)=s(e) FALSE. Only coherent reading is e⊖p_i (orthocomplement WITHIN e). FIX: rewrite as e⊖p_i, OR (advisor-recommended) replace footnote with a KS/Pitowsky citation — sidesteps the bug AND the low-novelty issue, more honest.

blocking_gaps.name: Stale biconditional from corrected Paper I
blocking_gaps.one_line: Paper II imports 'μ̂(pure(Ω))=1 ⟺ each ℓ_i σ-additive' UNCONDITIONALLY, but Paper I was corrected this session to state it realization-conditionally (σ-LS gap). Paper II now misrepresents its own cited source. Hedge the Boolean-half framing; crown jewel does NOT depend on it.

kills.name: Two-species underdetermination (philosophy upshot)
kills.one_line: Attempted to use Paper II as a philosophy flagship (realization-space underdetermination vs value-definite-completion impossibility, sorted by distributivity). KILLED: the distinction is already drawn (Egg–Saatsi 2021, Redhead 1987); and the OML-exclusive σ-layer is infinitary, invisible to finite empirical methods ⟹ fails as a practitioner diagnostic.

kills.name: Algebraic-vs-noise-misfit diagnostic
kills.one_line: The 'OML apparatus tells you algebraic vs statistical misfit' upshot = contextuality detection, already owned by Dzhafarov–Kujala CbD (with empirical wins). Paper II's σ-layer is infinitary; CbD is finite ⟹ on the empirical dimension OML is STRICTLY LESS applicable. FENCE: every philosophy-upshot route is owned; reposition §4 as POSITIONING, not novelty.

kills.name: arXiv:2603.22353 (Gunji) — dropped, not a gap
kills.one_line: Once listed as a Paper-II citation gap, then DROPPED 2026-06-22: Gunji's Bool-pushout theorem is machine-checked FALSE (the construction is the OML horizontal sum). The framing it supported re-attributed to Kalmbach + Abramsky–Brandenburger + Budroni–Morchio. Do NOT list as a current gap.

polish.name: 'No charge exists' overstatement
polish.one_line: Lines ~591/612 say 'no charge on S₀(L(H)) exists' (FALSE — Diracs exist); the proven claim is 'no charge EXTENDING s'. Align with the already-correct line 447.

polish.name: Cite Beltrametti–Cassinelli 1981
polish.one_line: EA/PR/VDR trichotomy pieces (statistical vs dispersion-free states) source to BC 1981; cite explicitly.
